title: Personal Checking Schedule of Monthly Maintenance Charges and Waiver Settings
content:
The monthly maintenance fee of a Personal Checking tier is the amount assessed once per statement cycle at cycle close unless a waiver the tier offers is met. Each waiver setting below is the level at or above which that waiver is met, or a note that the tier does not offer it at all.

| Tier | Monthly maintenance fee (USD) | Lowest end-of-day balance in the cycle (USD) | Total of direct deposits posted in the cycle (USD) | Relationship balance at cycle close (USD) | Posted debit card purchases in the cycle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 5.00 | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered |
| Everyday Checking | 12.00 | 1500.00 | 500.00 | 5000.00 | 10 |
| Interest Checking | 15.00 | 5000.00 | not offered | 15000.00 | not offered |
| Premier Checking | 25.00 | 10000.00 | not offered | 25000.00 | not offered |
| Private Client Checking | 35.00 | not offered | not offered | 250000.00 | not offered |

| Tier | Waived while the primary owner is younger than | Waived when the primary owner is at least | Active-duty military status waives the fee | Active employee status waives the fee | Outstanding mortgage principal counts toward this tier's relationship balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 25 | 65 | yes | yes | no |
| Student Checking | not offered | not offered | no | no | no |
| Everyday Checking | 25 | 65 | yes | yes | no |
| Interest Checking | not offered | 65 | yes | yes | no |
| Premier Checking | not offered | not offered | yes | yes | yes |
| Private Client Checking | not offered | not offered | no | yes | yes |

A setting of not offered means that waiver cannot be used on that tier. A fee figure of 0.00 means the tier carries no monthly maintenance fee.

**Points of judgement.** The age waivers read in opposite directions: the younger-than setting is met while the owner has not yet reached that age, and the at-least setting is met from the birthday on which the owner reaches it. On Everyday Checking, where both are offered, an owner aged 24 meets the younger-than waiver, an owner aged 65 meets the at-least waiver, and an owner aged 40 meets neither.
